basis: The chart displays two lines: a red dashed line for Urban (%) on the left Y-axis and a blue solid line for Rural (%) on the right Y-axis. At the 1990 x-axis mark, the red line (Urban) is positioned at approximately 12.5%, while the blue line (Rural) is at approximately 46.32%. The vertical position of the markers directly reflects their respective percentage values. Since 46.32% > 12.5%, the Rural percentage is larger in 1990. Therefore, the follow-up record for the Rural category must be opened.
